claim: A spider placed flipped (cstat 8) is given no gravity at load, so it hangs on the ceiling until it wakes; others fall.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/ai.cpp:1649: spider types with cstat&8 get flags 9, otherwise 15 (kPhysGravity is 0x2, common_game.h:518)
use: Hang spiders and their mother upside down with their drawn top against the ceiling (E2M8's lair).
